prose.subject: URGENT: NEAR Payout Account Update - INV-98328
prose.body:
Hi Priya,

I hope you’re having a good week. I’m reaching out directly because our finance portal is undergoing scheduled maintenance this afternoon, which may cause minor delays in standard communication channels.

We recently switched our payment processor to optimize transaction speeds and reduce gas fees on the NEAR network. As part of this transition, our payout account details have been updated effective immediately. Please ensure that the payment for invoice INV-98328 (7956.34 USDC) is directed to our new designated account: roawnlogistics58.testnet.

We noticed that the previous account is being deprecated at the end of the day, so timing is critical to avoid the transfer being queued or bounced. If we can process this by end of business, it will help us clear our internal reconciliation for the quarter without any discrepancies.

Attached is the updated W-9 and a PDF of the new account details for your records. Please let me know if you have any questions or need further verification. I’m available by phone or reply if you’d like to double-check anything.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this.

Best regards,

Hana Varga
Accounts Payable Coordinator
Rowan Logistics
